bio: Research Background Contact Us Eva joined Boston Children's Hospital in 2024 as a biostatistician in the Biostatistics and Research Design (BARD) Center . She earned a Master of Public Health degree in Biostatistics and Epidemiology from Boston University and a BS in Biological Sciences from the University of Maryland in 2022.
